verdict.rationale: The instructions are published openly on the justica.gov.pt service page. That page covers who can use the service, the authentication options, the steps, and exact fees, so anyone can read them before logging in. The forms are not downloadable: the incorporation form is completed inside the authenticated platform, and the pacto social is generated automatically from the entered data. There is no evidence that blank forms or the pre-approved pact models can be downloaded without an account, and the published eportugal.gov.pt entry URL returns 404. Missing for 10: downloadable blank forms or pre-approved pact templates accessible without authentication, downloadable instruction documents (e.g., PDF guides), and independent confirmation of no-account access.
